test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pandit Birju Maharaj is a legendary dancer of which Indian dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __Kathak__.***__Key Points__** 

 
• Kathak:

 
 
• Birju Maharaj is associated with Kathak.
 
• Kathak is a dance form of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It is from the word ‘Katha*, meaning ‘*the art of storytelling*.
 
• The Kathak dance form originated in north India and is very similar to the Bharatnatyam dance form.
 
• In ancient India, there were *Kathakars *who used to recite religious and mythological tales to the accompaniment of music, mime, and dance.
 
• *Vaishnavite cult *which swept North India in the 15th century and the resultant bhakti movement contributed to a whole new range of lyrics and musical forms.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is associated with Kathak.
 
 
• He belongs to* Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana* of Kathak.
